scope: Qualification-only null input to real CreateRestrictedToken; actual login token retained; original native error capture, first failure and deadlines unchanged.
required_evidence: Fresh disconnected VM040 passes original pristine-readiness checks.
All four roles have distinct empty D:/build_cache targets and fresh=false compiler artifacts, byte-bound stage inventories and original controller checks.
Original setup succeeds; no setup-after-owned-accounts or late-create fault marker.
Precreated V5 trace has exact header, contiguous sequence, one owner, at most 512 records and 512 KiB.
Exactly one NativeStartEntered, InjectedNativeCallStarting, InjectedNativeCallReturned and FirstFailure, in that order. One token derivation call, zero default-DACL and process creation calls.

Native failure captures nonzero Win32 error from the real call; original FirstFailure preserves Token / LaunchTokenDerivation and the same error; real login token Held, restricted output Rejected, launch/process/thread outputs Empty.
Original journal reserves native start once, preserves failure and Unknown; controller observations match immutable journal byte ranges and hashes. No assumed old late-create timeout shape.
Same original policy owner verifies and removes only its actually added right, preserves holder sets and closes its own policy resources.
One fixed 30-second quiet interval, one read of five allowlisted public files, separate transport closed, no retained-owner contact or replay.
failure_rule: Missing or contradictory evidence keeps the relevant gate open. Trace is diagnostic, not retirement authority.
diagnostic_coverage_exclusions: No trace promised before command retention or after append failure; absence proves nothing.
